meta.title: Contract Repository: refused for a user without the Category Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and verify Contract Repository is refused or absent
Repeat as a Category Manager and verify Contract Repository is available
Compare both role outcomes on the same Enterprise tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and verify Contract Repository is refused or absent; Repeat as a Category Manager and verify Contract Repository is available; Compare both role outcomes on the same Enterprise tenant

args.need: sign in as both the user without the Category Manager role and the Category Manager on the same Enterprise tenant, open Contract Repository, and verify that access is refused or absent for the first user but available for the Category Manager

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as alternate users, navigate Contract Repository, or inspect this role-based permission outcome.
Confirm the tester's resulting screen is not showing a crash or server error after the delegated role comparison.
